# resilience

Timeouts before retries, retry with backoff+jitter, circuit breaker and bulkhead - the AWS Builders' Library canon behind AF-PERF-005/007.

## Rules

| Rule | Severity | Title |
|---|---|---|
| `AF-PERF-005` | high | Timeouts exist before retries, and retries carry jitter |
| `AF-PERF-007` | medium | Sync work does not block the request path unnecessarily |
